package streamidentity_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	events "example.com/streamidentity/gen/events"
	hc "example.com/streamidentity/gen/http/events/client"
	hs "example.com/streamidentity/gen/http/events/server"
	rc "example.com/streamidentity/gen/jsonrpc/rpcevents/client"
	rs "example.com/streamidentity/gen/jsonrpc/rpcevents/server"
	rpc "example.com/streamidentity/gen/rpcevents"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type httpService struct{}

func (httpService) Watch(ctx context.Context, p *events.WatchPayload, s events.WatchServerStream) (*events.Summary, error) {
	if err := s.SendWithContext(ctx, &events.Chunk{Value: "wire"}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return nil, s.Close()
}

type rpcService struct{}

func (rpcService) Watch(ctx context.Context, p *rpc.WatchPayload, s rpc.WatchServerStream) (*rpc.Summary, error) {
	return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &rpc.Chunk{Value: "wire"})
}

type httpAudit struct {
	t *testing.T
}

func (a httpAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *events.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	v := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Equal(a.t, "wire", v.Value())
	v.SetValue("accessed")
	return res, nil
}

type rpcAudit struct {
	t *testing.T
}

func (a rpcAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	v := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Equal(a.t, "wire", v.Value())
	v.SetValue("accessed")
	return res, nil
}
func TestMountedStreamIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, intercepted := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "control"
		want := "wire"
		if intercepted {
			name = "intercepted"
			want = "accessed"
		}
		t.Run("http/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			hs.Mount(mux, hs.New(events.NewEndpoints(httpService{}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
			srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
			defer srv.Close()
			transport := hc.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://"), srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			var audit events.ClientInterceptors
			if intercepted {
				audit = httpAudit{t}
			}
			c := events.NewClient(transport.Watch(), transport.WatchStream(), audit)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			st, err := c.WatchStream(ctx, &events.WatchPayload{})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			defer func() {
				require.NoError(t, st.Close())
			}()
			require.NotPanics(t, func() {
				v, err := st.Recv()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, want, v.Value)
				_, err = st.Recv()
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
			}, "typed stream result accessor must target Chunk")
		})
		t.Run("jsonrpc/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			rs.Mount(mux, rs.New(rpc.NewEndpoints(rpcService{}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil))
			srv := httptest.NewServer(mux)
			defer srv.Close()
			transport := rc.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(srv.URL, "http://"), srv.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			var audit rpc.ClientInterceptors
			if intercepted {
				audit = rpcAudit{t}
			}
			c := rpc.NewClient(transport.Watch(), transport.Watch(), audit)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			id := "one"
			st, err := c.WatchStream(ctx, &rpc.WatchPayload{ID: &id})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			defer func() {
				require.NoError(t, st.Close())
			}()
			require.NotPanics(t, func() {
				v, err := st.Recv()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, want, v.Value)
				_, err = st.Recv()
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
			}, "typed stream result accessor must target Chunk")
		})
	}
}
